name: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual mark volatility
description: Realized volatility of the Binance USD-M BTCUSDT perpetual mark price (socket mark-price stream or the REST premium-index poll), sampled once per second off the decision clock and converted to simple basis-point returns. volatility_bps_10s, volatility_bps_1m, volatility_bps_5m and volatility_bps_15m are the root mean square of the one-second returns inside the trailing 10-second, 1-minute, 5-minute and 15-minute windows. short_long_ratio is the 10-second value divided by the 15-minute value; when both windows have zero root mean square the ratio is 1 and the regime is stable. regime is contracting when short_long_ratio is at most 0.8, expanding when it is at least 1.2, otherwise stable; the 0.8 and 1.2 boundaries are research-default values. Ready output requires 901 contiguous one-second samples (the longest horizon, 15 minutes) of the mark; each one-second sample holds the venue's latest mark row for up to a 3-second bound (a research default that admits the sub-1 Hz mark cadence, the premium-index poll landing about every 1.3 seconds and Bybit mark prices carrying multi-second gaps), and a mark row 3 seconds or more old — a stalled poll or an absent mark — is a missing observation that breaks continuity and restarts the warm-up (no gap bridging). Warm-up degrades as binance_warming_up, a stale merged mark as binance_stale and a mark-missing feed state as binance_recovery_required. The Binance USD-M lane refuses to start (exit 78) unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists binance; the rights gate is a startup refusal, never an instance status. This identity is reference-free and scale-free: it publishes no price-denominated field, only basis-point returns and their root mean square, so nothing is converted from USDT to USD. There is no usdt_usd_rate, no usdt_usd_rate_age_ms and no usdt_reference_stale gating; returns are quote-neutral by construction. quote_currency is the constant "usd". Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
